Privacy Policy & Data Protection Notice

Effective Date: January 1, 2026 • Last Updated: October 2026

GSTIN: 32AYKPL3446P1ZZ

TEAM L LOGISTICS AND HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT (registered under Legal Name LIBIN LINSON, brand name "Team L"), having its principal place of business at 3rd Floor, V1707, Bldg No. 60/44, JC Chambers, Panampilly Nagar Road, Opp Kairali Apartments, Panampilly Nagar, Kochi, Ernakulam, Kerala - 682036, is committed to safeguarding the privacy and security of all personal and corporate data collected from clients, guests, suppliers, and website visitors.

1. Information We Collect

  • Corporate & Contact Identifiers: Full name, organization name, job title, official email address, telephone/WhatsApp number (+91 87142 25254), GSTIN, and billing/shipping addresses provided through RFQ forms or contracts.
  • Hospitality & Guest Records: Guest check-in/check-out logs, statutory ID verification records, and facility preferences required for executive guest house management.
  • Logistics & Telemetry Data: Consignment manifests, e-Way Bill references, delivery acknowledgments, and GPS route telemetry.

2. Meta Platform & WhatsApp Business API Messaging Compliance

We use collected contact information strictly to fulfill contracted hospitality and logistics services, issue GST tax invoices, send real-time dispatch/booking updates, and provide customer support. When you explicitly opt in via our website forms or onboarding agreements, we may send transactional notifications, delivery alerts, booking confirmations, and support responses via WhatsApp Business API, SMS, phone, or email. You may opt out of automated messages at any time by replying STOP or contacting our Grievance Desk.

3. Data Confidentiality & Zero Third-Party Sale

Team L never sells, rents, or trades client phone numbers or personal data to third-party advertisers. Information is shared solely with authorized operational personnel or regulatory authorities as required under Indian law.

4. Data Protection & Grievance Officer Contact

For data access, correction, erasure, or privacy inquiries, contact: LIBIN LINSON (TEAM L LOGISTICS AND HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT), Email: contact@teamlsolutions.com, Phone: +91 87142 25254.

Terms of Service & Master Operational Conditions

Governing Corporate Hospitality & B2B Logistics Engagements

1. Scope of Engagement

TEAM L LOGISTICS AND HOSPITALITY MANAGEMENT (Proprietor: LIBIN LINSON) provides corporate guest house management, VIP event concierge, facility administration, dedicated fleet transport, and warehousing services under confirmed Work Orders or Master Service Agreements (MSAs).

2. Consignment Declarations & Guest House Protocols

Clients engaging our logistics division warrant that all goods consigned are accurately declared with valid GST e-Way Bills and exclude contraband or undeclared hazardous goods. Corporate guests occupying managed transit suites must comply with statutory government ID verification norms.

3. Billing, GST & Settlement Terms

All services are billed under GST Registration Number 32AYKPL3446P1ZZ. Standard corporate invoices carry Net-15 or Net-30 settlement terms from invoice issuance unless otherwise stipulated in the MSA.

4. Governing Law & Jurisdiction

These Terms are governed by the laws of the Republic of India, with exclusive jurisdiction vested in the competent courts at Kochi, Ernakulam, Kerala, India.

SLA Commitment, Cancellation & Refund Policy

Transparent SLA Credits & Booking Resolution for Enterprise Clients

1. Hospitality & VIP Event Bookings

Cancellations requested more than 72 hours prior to a scheduled corporate guest house check-in or event deployment qualify for a 100% refund or full retainer credit adjustment. Cancellations within 24–72 hours incur a 25% resource allocation charge.

2. B2B Logistics & Dedicated Fleet Dispatches

Fleet and freight orders may be canceled without penalty prior to vehicle dispatch from our hub. Once a vehicle is positioned at the loading dock, standard base positioning tariffs apply.

3. SLA Performance Credits & Refund Timelines

Approved refunds or SLA credit notes are processed within 5–7 business days via the original corporate payment channel (NEFT/RTGS/IMPS). For billing support, reach our Kochi headquarters desk at contact@teamlsolutions.com or +91 87142 25254.
